page.layout: One column of table-of-contents entries, with page numbers at the right and brace-grouped sub-entries; running head at top; signature "d 4" at foot; "CAP. 21." set in the right margin beside the line "De ritibus nuptiarum". The left printed page is only partly visible at the left edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Consensus liber esse debet vel spontaneus & plenus. 520
Quæ ex his species conjugium dirimant, vel minus. ibid.
De sponsalibus cum corrupta discrimen inter jus Mosaicum & Civile. 522
Conditiones sponsalibus de futuro adjectæ quotuplices, quæ item earum ratio. 532
si altera pars alleget, altera neget. ibid.
Quamdiu sponsum absentem exspectare sponsa teneatur. ibid.
Uxor etiam maritum absentem exspectare tenetur. 538
An uxor maritum relegatum sequi teneatur. 540
Cur aquâ & igni matrimonia olim inita. ibid.

page.notes: The left printed page, visible only at the edge (fragments such as "Canonisa", "quatuor", "conjugium"), is excluded as the neighbouring page. The pagination "ibid." entries are as printed. The "Sponsalia" and "Ritus sponsalium" groups are rendered as outlines from the printed braces. "CAP. 21." is a marginal mark beside line 543 and is kept as a right-side note.
